description: Figure 2, titled "Performance with different chunking sizes," is a line plot that illustrates the performance of different retrieval strategies as a function of the number of tokens used for chunking. The x-axis, labeled "Number of Tokens," is a linear scale ranging from 200 to 1000, with major tick marks at 200, 400, 600, 800, and 1000. The y-axis, labeled "Performance," is also a linear scale ranging from 10 to 40. The legend indicates four data series, each representing a different source: "Tutorials" (blue line with circular markers), "Library Documentation" (red line with circular markers), "StackOverflow posts" (yellow line with circular markers), and "Github files" (green line with circular markers). The "Tutorials" line starts at approximately 23 and increases to about 29. The "Library Documentation" line starts at approximately 28 and increases to about 32. The "StackOverflow posts" line starts at approximately 32 and decreases to about 15. The "Github files" line starts at approximately 28 and increases to about 33. The performance of "Tutorials" and "Library Documentation" generally increases with the number of tokens, while the performance of "StackOverflow posts" decreases. The performance of "Github files" shows a slight increase.
